```{r bounds-check}
bounds_check <- map_dfr(DATASETS, function(ds) {
  d  <- data_list[[ds]]
  ty <- COVARIATE_TYPES[[ds]]
  cols <- names(ty)[map_lgl(ty, ~ identical(.x, "continuous"))]
  map_dfr(cols, function(cl) {
    x  <- d[[cl]]
    ob <- as.numeric(CLIPPING_BOUNDS[[ds]][[cl]])
    fx <- as.numeric(CLIPPING_BOUNDS_FIXED[[ds]][[cl]])
    wd <- as.numeric(CLIPPING_BOUNDS_WIDE[[ds]][[cl]])
    tibble(
      dataset = ds, variable = cl,
      obs = sprintf("[%g, %g]", ob[1], ob[2]),
      fixed = sprintf("[%g, %g]", fx[1], fx[2]),
      widened = sprintf("[%g, %g]", wd[1], wd[2]),
      fixed_ratio   = (fx[2] - fx[1]) / (ob[2] - ob[1]),
      fixed_clip_pct = mean(x < fx[1] | x > fx[2]) * 100,
      widened_ratio = (wd[2] - wd[1]) / (ob[2] - ob[1]),
      widened_clip_pct = mean(x < wd[1] | x > wd[2]) * 100
    )
  })
})

bounds_check <- bounds_check %>%
  mutate(unit_flag = if_else(fixed_ratio < 1 | fixed_ratio > 50, "要確認", ""))

kable(bounds_check, digits = 4,
      caption = "境界幅 ÷ 観測幅とクリップ発生率（fixed / widened）")

cat(sprintf("\n[検査 1] 1〜50 倍の外側にある変数: %d / %d\n",
            sum(bounds_check$unit_flag == "要確認"), nrow(bounds_check)))
cat(sprintf("[検査 1] fixed でクリップが生じる変数: %d / %d\n",
            sum(bounds_check$fixed_clip_pct > 0), nrow(bounds_check)))
print(bounds_check %>% filter(unit_flag == "要確認" | fixed_clip_pct > 0) %>%
        select(dataset, variable, obs, fixed, fixed_ratio, fixed_clip_pct))
```

```{r callr-helper}
run_bounds_sim_isolated <- function(data, dataset_name, arm, eps_values, B, seed) {
  callr::r(
    function(data, dataset_name, arm, eps_values, B, seed) {
      library(survival); library(dplyr); library(furrr); library(progressr)

      source("/home/rstudio/project/main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/dp_input_perturbation_phase1.R")
      source("/home/rstudio/project/main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/dp_bounds_comparison.R")
      source("/home/rstudio/project/main/03_simulation/R/dp_fast.R")
      source("/home/rstudio/project/main/03_simulation/R/simulation_engine.R")
      source("/home/rstudio/project/main/03_simulation/R/data_split.R")

      n_workers <- min(10, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
      Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1", MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
                 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1", RCPP_PARALLEL_NUM_THREADS = "1")
      plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

      bounds_all <- get(BOUNDS_ARM_BOUNDS[[arm]])
      bounds <- bounds_all[[dataset_name]]
      types  <- COVARIATE_TYPES[[dataset_name]]
      perturb_fn <- function(data, epsilon) {
        perturb_covariates_phase1_fast(data, bounds, epsilon, types,
                                       preserve_factor_levels = TRUE)
      }

      result <- run_simulation_batch(
        data = data, perturb_fn = perturb_fn,
        epsilon_values = eps_values, B = B,
        base_seed = seed, cox_formula = COX_FORMULAS[[dataset_name]],
        dataset_name = dataset_name
      )
      plan(sequential)
      result$arm <- arm
      result
    },
    args = list(data = data, dataset_name = dataset_name, arm = arm,
                eps_values = eps_values, B = B, seed = seed)
  )
}

run_arm <- function(arm, B) {
  map_dfr(DATASETS, function(ds) {
    seed <- unname(BOUNDS_DATASET_BASE_SEED[ds] + BOUNDS_ARM_SEED_OFFSET[arm])
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    res <- run_bounds_sim_isolated(data_list[[ds]], ds, arm, EPSILON_VALUES, B, seed)
    cat(sprintf("[%s/%s] B=%d done in %.1f s (base_seed=%d)\n", arm, ds, B,
                as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")), seed))
    res
  })
}
```

```{r check-functions}
REF_PARQUET <- file.path(PROJ, "data/03_simulation/reffix/all_phase1_reffix.parquet")

check_convergence <- function(res, label, B_expected = NULL) {
  by_eps <- res %>%
    group_by(arm, dataset, epsilon) %>%
    summarise(n_sims = n_distinct(iteration),
              n_conv = sum(converged[!duplicated(iteration)]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(cfr_pct = 100 * (1 - n_conv / n_sims))

  conv <- by_eps %>%
    group_by(arm, dataset) %>%
    summarise(n_sims = sum(n_sims), n_conv = sum(n_conv),
              max_cfr_pct_by_eps = max(cfr_pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(cfr_pct = 100 * (1 - n_conv / n_sims))
  print(kable(conv, digits = 4,
              caption = sprintf("%s: アーム × データセット別の収束失敗率（停止条件は ε 単位で判定する。%s）",
                                label, "max_cfr_pct_by_eps = そのデータセット内で最大の ε 単位 CFR")))

  bad <- by_eps %>% filter(n_conv < n_sims)
  if (nrow(bad) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("[%s 確認 1] 収束失敗ゼロ（全 2 アーム × 5 データセット × %d ε）\n",
                label, length(EPSILON_VALUES)))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("[%s 確認 1] ⚠️ 収束失敗あり。内訳:\n", label))
    print(as.data.frame(bad))
  }
  fail_rows <- res %>% filter(!converged)
  hard_fail <- fail_rows %>% filter(variable == "FAILED")

  conv_ref <- res %>%
    filter(converged, variable != "FAILED", is.finite(beta)) %>%
    group_by(arm, dataset, epsilon, variable) %>%
    summarise(ref_abs_beta = max(abs(beta)), .groups = "drop")

  benign_iter <- fail_rows %>%
    group_by(arm, dataset, epsilon, iteration) %>%
    summarise(
      shape_ok = all(variable != "FAILED") & all(is.finite(beta)) & all(is.finite(se)) &
                 all(grepl("Loglik converged before variable", error_msg, fixed = TRUE)),
      warn_idx = suppressWarnings(as.integer(
        sub(".*variable\\s+([0-9]+).*", "\\1", error_msg[1]))),
      n_coef   = n(),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(fail_rows %>%
                group_by(arm, dataset, epsilon, iteration) %>%
                mutate(.pos = row_number()) %>%
                ungroup() %>%
                select(arm, dataset, epsilon, iteration, .pos, variable, beta),
              by = c("arm", "dataset", "epsilon", "iteration")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(warn_idx) & .pos == warn_idx) %>%
    rename(warn_var = variable, warn_beta = beta) %>%
    right_join(fail_rows %>% distinct(arm, dataset, epsilon, iteration),
               by = c("arm", "dataset", "epsilon", "iteration")) %>%
    left_join(conv_ref, by = c("arm", "dataset", "epsilon", "warn_var" = "variable")) %>%
    mutate(benign = coalesce(shape_ok, FALSE) &
                    !is.na(warn_beta) & !is.na(ref_abs_beta) &
                    abs(warn_beta) <= ref_abs_beta) %>%
    select(arm, dataset, epsilon, iteration, benign, warn_var, warn_beta, ref_abs_beta)
  by_eps <- by_eps %>%
    left_join(benign_iter %>% group_by(arm, dataset, epsilon) %>%
                summarise(n_benign = sum(benign), .groups = "drop"),
              by = c("arm", "dataset", "epsilon")) %>%
    mutate(n_benign = coalesce(n_benign, 0L),
           n_fail = n_sims - n_conv,
           n_nonbenign = n_fail - n_benign,
           cfr_nonbenign_pct = 100 * n_nonbenign / n_sims)

  if (any(by_eps$n_fail > 0)) {
    print(kable(by_eps %>% filter(n_fail > 0) %>%
                  select(arm, dataset, epsilon, n_sims, n_fail, n_benign, n_nonbenign,
                         cfr_pct, cfr_nonbenign_pct),
                digits = 4,
                caption = sprintf("%s: 収束失敗の内訳（良性 = coxph の警告のみ・係数は有限）", label)))
  }

  overall_cfr <- 100 * sum(by_eps$n_fail) / sum(by_eps$n_sims)
  cat(sprintf("[%s] 全体 CFR = %.4f%%（真の失敗 %d 件 / 良性の警告 %d 件 / 全 %d 反復）\n",
              label, overall_cfr, nrow(hard_fail), sum(by_eps$n_benign), sum(by_eps$n_sims)))

  if (nrow(benign_iter %>% filter(!benign)) > 0) {
    print(kable(benign_iter %>% filter(!benign) %>%
                  select(arm, dataset, epsilon, iteration, warn_var, warn_beta, ref_abs_beta),
                digits = 8,
                caption = sprintf("%s: 良性と判定されなかった失敗（warn_var = 警告が名指しした変数）",
                                  label)))
  }

  viol <- c(
    if (nrow(hard_fail) > 0)
      sprintf("  (a) error 分岐の真の失敗が %d 行ある", nrow(hard_fail)),
    {
      b <- by_eps %>% filter(cfr_nonbenign_pct > 1.0)
      if (nrow(b) > 0) sprintf("  (b) %s / %s / eps=%g: 良性でない失敗 %d/%d (CFR %.2f%%)",
                               b$arm, b$dataset, b$epsilon, b$n_nonbenign, b$n_sims,
                               b$cfr_nonbenign_pct)
    },
    {
      b <- by_eps %>% filter(cfr_pct > 5.0)
      if (nrow(b) > 0) sprintf("  (c) %s / %s / eps=%g: 良性を含めても CFR %.2f%% が 5%% を超える",
                               b$arm, b$dataset, b$epsilon, b$cfr_pct)
    },
    if (overall_cfr > 0.1) sprintf("  (d) 全体 CFR %.4f%% が 0.1%% を超える", overall_cfr),
    {
      if (!is.null(B_expected)) {
        b <- by_eps %>% filter(n_sims != B_expected)
        if (nrow(b) > 0) sprintf("  (e) %s / %s / eps=%g: 反復数 %d（期待 %d）",
                                 b$arm, b$dataset, b$epsilon, b$n_sims, B_expected)
      }
    }
  )
  if (length(viol) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf("[%s] 収束の停止条件に触れた:\n%s", label, paste(viol, collapse = "\n")))
  }
  invisible(conv)
}

check_schema <- function(res, label) {
  ref_cols <- arrow::open_dataset(REF_PARQUET)$schema$names
  new_cols <- names(res)
  cat(sprintf("[%s] 既存 phase1 の列: %s\n", label, paste(ref_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  cat(sprintf("[%s] 新アームの列    : %s\n", label, paste(new_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  stopifnot(identical(setdiff(new_cols, ref_cols), "arm"))
  stopifnot(length(setdiff(ref_cols, new_cols)) == 0)
  cat(sprintf("[%s 確認 2] スキーマ一致 OK（既存の全列 + arm 列のみ追加）\n", label))
  invisible(TRUE)
}

clip_diff_datasets <- function(arm) {
  bounds_all <- get(BOUNDS_ARM_BOUNDS[[arm]])
  out <- character(0)
  for (ds in DATASETS) {
    d <- data_list[[ds]]
    ty <- COVARIATE_TYPES[[ds]]
    differs <- FALSE
    for (v in names(ty)) {
      if (ty[[v]] != "continuous") next
      bd <- CLIPPING_BOUNDS[[ds]][[v]]
      ba <- bounds_all[[ds]][[v]]
      if (!identical(pmin(pmax(d[[v]], bd[1]), bd[2]),
                     pmin(pmax(d[[v]], ba[1]), ba[2]))) { differs <- TRUE; break }
    }
    if (differs) out <- c(out, ds)
  }
  out
}

check_inf_identity <- function(res, label, out_csv) {
  dd_inf <- read_parquet(REF_PARQUET) %>%
    filter(is.infinite(epsilon), converged, variable != "FAILED") %>%
    distinct(dataset, iteration, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(dataset) %>% summarise(`data-driven` = mean(c_index), .groups = "drop")

  arm_inf <- res %>%
    filter(is.infinite(epsilon), converged, variable != "FAILED") %>%
    distinct(arm, dataset, iteration, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(arm, dataset) %>%
    summarise(c = mean(c_index), sd = sd(c_index), .groups = "drop")
  stopifnot(all(arm_inf$sd == 0))

  inf_tbl <- dd_inf %>%
    left_join(arm_inf %>% select(-sd) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = c),
              by = "dataset") %>%
    mutate(identical_fixed   = fixed   == `data-driven`,
           identical_widened = widened == `data-driven`)
  print(kable(inf_tbl, digits = 10,
              caption = sprintf("%s: ε=∞ での C-index（アーム間の一致検査）", label)))
  write_csv(inf_tbl, out_csv)

  may_fixed   <- clip_diff_datasets("fixed")
  may_widened <- clip_diff_datasets("widened")
  got_fixed   <- inf_tbl$dataset[!inf_tbl$identical_fixed]
  got_widened <- inf_tbl$dataset[!inf_tbl$identical_widened]
  cat(sprintf("[%s] クリップ結果が data-driven と違うデータセット: fixed = {%s} / widened = {%s}\n",
              label, paste(may_fixed, collapse = ", "), paste(may_widened, collapse = ", ")))
  cat(sprintf("[%s] 実際に C-index が動いたデータセット:         fixed = {%s} / widened = {%s}\n",
              label, paste(got_fixed, collapse = ", "), paste(got_widened, collapse = ", ")))
  unexplained <- c(setdiff(got_fixed, may_fixed), setdiff(got_widened, may_widened))
  if (length(unexplained) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf("[%s] クリップで説明できない差がある: %s", label,
                 paste(unique(unexplained), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  cat(sprintf("[%s 確認 3b] ε=∞ の差はすべてクリップの違いで説明できる\n", label))
  invisible(inf_tbl)
}

check_inf_refit <- function(res, label) {
  out <- map_dfr(names(BOUNDS_ARM_BOUNDS), function(arm) {
    bounds_all <- get(BOUNDS_ARM_BOUNDS[[arm]])
    map_dfr(DATASETS, function(ds) {
      d  <- set_reference_levels(as.data.frame(data_list[[ds]]), ds)
      pd <- perturb_covariates_phase1_fast(d, bounds_all[[ds]], Inf, COVARIATE_TYPES[[ds]],
                                           preserve_factor_levels = TRUE)
      fit <- coxph(COX_FORMULAS[[ds]], data = pd)
      ref <- tibble(variable = names(coef(fit)), beta_ref = unname(coef(fit)),
                    se_ref = unname(sqrt(diag(vcov(fit)))))
      got <- res %>%
        filter(arm == !!arm, dataset == ds, is.infinite(epsilon), iteration == min(iteration)) %>%
        select(variable, beta, se)
      j <- inner_join(ref, got, by = "variable")
      tibble(arm = arm, dataset = ds,
             n_ref = nrow(ref), n_got = nrow(got), n_joined = nrow(j),
             max_abs_diff_beta = if (nrow(j)) max(abs(j$beta - j$beta_ref)) else NA_real_,
             max_abs_diff_se   = if (nrow(j)) max(abs(j$se   - j$se_ref))   else NA_real_)
    })
  })
  print(kable(out, digits = 16,
              caption = sprintf("%s: ε=∞ の成果物を各アームの箱から再計算して突合", label)))
  stopifnot(all(out$n_ref == out$n_joined), all(out$n_got == out$n_joined))
  bad <- out %>% filter(max_abs_diff_beta != 0 | max_abs_diff_se != 0)
  if (nrow(bad) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf("[%s] ε=∞ の成果物が宣言した箱から再現できない:\n%s", label,
                 paste(sprintf("  %s / %s: |Δβ| = %g / |Δse| = %g",
                               bad$arm, bad$dataset,
                               bad$max_abs_diff_beta, bad$max_abs_diff_se), collapse = "\n")))
  }
  cat(sprintf("[%s 確認 3c] ε=∞ の成果物は各アームの箱からビット単位で再現できる\n", label))
  invisible(out)
}

check_arm_results <- function(res, label, out_csv, B_expected = NULL) {
  check_convergence(res, label, B_expected = B_expected)
  check_schema(res, label)
  check_inf_identity(res, label, out_csv)
  check_inf_refit(res, label)
  cat(sprintf("\n=== [%s] 4 検査すべて合格 ===\n", label))
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r calibration-report}
b_slope <- (cal_secs - smoke_secs_fixed) / (100 - B_SMOKE)
a_fixed <- smoke_secs_fixed - b_slope * B_SMOKE
est_1000_arm <- a_fixed + b_slope * B_PRODUCTION

cat(sprintf("実測: B=%d %.1f 秒 / B=100 %.1f 秒\n", B_SMOKE, smoke_secs_fixed, cal_secs))
cat(sprintf("当てはめ: 固定費 a = %.1f 秒 / 限界コスト b = %.3f 秒/反復\n", a_fixed, b_slope))
cat(sprintf("B=%d 外挿: 1 アーム %.1f 分 / 2 アーム合計 %.1f 分\n",
            B_PRODUCTION, est_1000_arm / 60, 2 * est_1000_arm / 60))
cat(sprintf("（素朴な線形外挿 %.1f 分 との差 = 固定費の二重計上分）\n",
            2 * smoke_secs_fixed * B_PRODUCTION / B_SMOKE / 60))
```

```{r smoke-cindex}
  filter(converged, variable != "FAILED") %>%
  distinct(arm, dataset, epsilon, iteration, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(arm, dataset, epsilon) %>%
  summarise(mean_c = mean(c_index, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = mean_c)
kable(cidx, digits = 4,
      caption = sprintf("B=%d スモーク: ε 別平均 C-index（参考値。B が小さいため推定精度は低い）", B_SMOKE))
```

```{r smoke-save}
for (a in c("fixed", "widened")) {
  outdir <- file.path(PROJ, "data/03_simulation", BOUNDS_ARM_OUTPUT_DIR[[a]])
  dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dat <- smoke_results %>% filter(arm == a)
  for (ds in DATASETS) {
    sub <- dat %>% filter(dataset == ds)
    write_csv(sub, file.path(outdir, sprintf("%s_phase1_%s_smoke.csv", ds, a)))
    write_parquet(sub, file.path(outdir, sprintf("%s_phase1_%s_smoke.parquet", ds, a)))
  }
  write_csv(dat, file.path(outdir, sprintf("all_phase1_%s_smoke.csv", a)))
  write_parquet(dat, file.path(outdir, sprintf("all_phase1_%s_smoke.parquet", a)))
  cat("saved:", outdir, "\n")
}
```

```{r nondestructive}
protected_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(PROJ, "data/03_simulation", c("phase1_covariates", "reffix")),
                               mustWork = FALSE)
write_dirs <- vapply(BOUNDS_ARM_OUTPUT_DIR, function(d) {

  normalizePath(p, mustWork = TRUE)
}, character(1L))

cat("保護対象ディレクトリ:", protected_dir, "\n")
cat("本 Rmd の書き込み先  :", paste(write_dirs, collapse = " / "), "\n")
stopifnot(!any(write_dirs %in% protected_dir))
stopifnot(!any(outer(write_dirs, paste0(protected_dir, .Platform$file.sep), startsWith)))
```

```{r production-run, eval=RUN_PRODUCTION}
t_p0 <- Sys.time()

prod_widened <- run_arm("widened", B_PRODUCTION)
prod_results <- bind_rows(prod_fixed, prod_widened)
cat(sprintf("production done in %.1f min\n",
            as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_p0, units = "mins"))))

saveRDS(prod_results,
        file.path(PROJ, "data/03_simulation/phase1_bounds_fixed/.prod_raw.rds"))
cat("[退避] data/03_simulation/phase1_bounds_fixed/.prod_raw.rds に生の結果を書き出した\n")

check_arm_results(
  prod_results,
  label   = sprintf("B=%d 本番", B_PRODUCTION),
  out_csv = file.path(PROJ, "data/03_simulation/phase1_bounds_fixed/inf_identity_production.csv"),
  B_expected = B_PRODUCTION
)

unlink(file.path(PROJ, "data/03_simulation/phase1_bounds_fixed/.prod_raw.rds"))

    write_parquet(sub, file.path(outdir, sprintf("%s_phase1_%s.parquet", ds, a)))

  write_csv(dat, file.path(outdir, sprintf("all_phase1_%s.csv", a)))
  write_parquet(dat, file.path(outdir, sprintf("all_phase1_%s.parquet", a)))
```
